title: stk doctor --json
description: What `stk doctor --json` prints on stdout: each setup check and the isolation verdict. stk exits 1 when a check failed and still prints this. Written from supertoolkit internal/doctor/doctor_isolation.go (`jsonCheck`) and internal/isolation/isolation.go (`Report`). AgentPod's node-agent requires `isolation.level` (stkclient.go, Doctor). On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).

ok.description: Not failed: a warning is ok.

warn.description: Present, and true, only for a warning.

method.description: How the level was found; omitted when it is unknown.
